_note: Fab design rules used for defaults and warnings. Every number carries its source. mm unless stated.

via.min_hole_source: capabilities: minimum via hole size 0.15 mm (2+ layers)
via.plating_source: JLCPCB support, reported on the EasyEDA forum: hole wall copper 18 um average. IPC-6012 class 2 asks 20 um; treat 18-20 um as the range.
via.drill_oversize_source: JLCPCB blog (pcb-plating-thickness): the factory drills about 0.1 mm larger than the specified finished hole to compensate for plating.
via.drill_to_copper_source: capabilities: inner-layer via hole to copper 0.2 mm
via.covering_source: capabilities + JLCPCB blog 'five via finishes'. Standard vias are hollow plated barrels; copper-paste fill is an ordered option for via-in-pad (0.15-0.55 mm holes).
via.default_source: user default (Mateusz, 2026-08-30): 0.3 mm hole, 0.6 mm copper diameter
via.sizes_source: first entry: user default (Mateusz 2026-08-30); second: JLCPCB capabilities minimums

copper.source: stackup page: outer 0.035 mm, inner 0.0152 mm; capabilities: inner 0.5 oz default. The JLCPCB impedance calculator itself assumes 1.6 mil (0.041 mm) outer, 1.2 mil (0.030 mm) inner.

soldermask.source: capabilities: solder mask thickness >= 10 um; impedance page model: 1.2 mil over substrate, 0.6 mil over trace, Dk 3.8

etch.source: JLCPCB publishes no undercut. JLCPCB blog 'how-etch-factor-controls-pcb-trace-width': production etch factor 2.5-4.0, example 1 oz at EF 3.5 = 10 um/side. Z-zero 'Etch effects explained': average suppliers ~0.5 mil (12.7 um)/side for 1 oz, ~0.25 mil (6.4 um) for 0.5 oz; 0.5 mil etchback shifts 50 ohm by ~1.25 ohm. Values here are industry-typical, mark as assumed.

mask.source: https://jlcpcb.com/impedance: C1 1.2 mil over substrate, C2 0.6 mil over trace, CEr 3.8. tand not published, 0.02 assumed.
mask.expansion_source: mask opening beyond the exposed copper; 0.05 mm is a common default (assumed, JLCPCB does not publish a fixed value for custom openings)

finish.source: JLCPCB default finish lead-free HASL; thickness 1-50 um per JLCPCB blog, 10 um assumed. ENIG: Ni 3-6 um + Au 0.025-0.05 um.
